videoRange.timebase: Raw recorded video seconds, verified against extracted frames at 41.5, 42.0 and 43.2 seconds. The HUD-hidden cut retains continuous original footage through completion/retraction.

visualReview.firstPerson: Car and mounted head are unobstructed; no civilian-car overlap is visible in the representative first-person frame.
visualReview.shoulder: The player avatar partially obscures the car, so first-person is the clearer view of the mechanism.
visualReview.limitations: The tool remains a coarse fixed gantry with a thin repair beam, not a localized articulated bodywork operation.
